title: Erythromycin fermentation process dataset
publisher: Yan, Xuefeng (East China University of Science and Technology); Sun, Yifei (East China University of Science and Technology)

substitution.reason: HTTP 403 from public page and payload; public browser timed out
substitution.selection: First three ordered measured-data reserves; preserves overall corpus breadth but reduces new survey and environmental additions.

measurement_dates: Description says 2022; retained rows span December 26, 2021 to November 14, 2022 in file order. Preserve mismatch.
author_preprocessing: Historical industrial exports: 50,536 rows, 406 batches, and hx as the chemical-potency target selected by the source loader. Several process abbreviations and physical units are not defined in the deposit; no meanings are guessed.
known_analyses_and_limitations: Keep all samples of each batch together. Restrict currently defensible modeling to documented target/time/batch structure and explicitly source-unit or dimensionless response; physical laws involving unmapped process variables need an additional verified dictionary. The description claims an average of 154 samples per batch, while the retained 50,536 rows imply about 124.5; preserve this inconsistency.
independent_groups: complete fermentation batches, chronological batch blocks
